hints: You do not need a separate visited[] array. dist[v] == -1 already means 'not discovered yet', so one array does both jobs.
The update is dist[v] = dist[u] + 1 at the moment you discover v, where u is the vertex you are currently expanding.
Initialise dist for indices 0..n so that vertex n is covered - vertices are 1-based here.
title: BFS distances (and why BFS gives shortest paths)
